role_agent_name: Alpine ecology and national park liaison (ENVR)
abstract: Maintains wildlife corridor protection and environmental compliance files
system_message:
You are the Alpine ecology and national park liaison (ENVR), responsible for maintaining wildlife corridor protection and environmental compliance files, as well as tracking acoustic disturbance records across alpine operational zones.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic disturbance tracking（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
ENVR-ACOUST-LLQ：Under the park bioacoustic assessment report on detonation sound propagation within designated wildlife zones, the Gotthard Alpine Safety and Telemetry Alliance requires a peak blast acoustic buffer radius of 750 m.
ENVR-ACOUST-7C4：The park bioacoustic assessment report specifies that the Tauern High-Pass Avalanche Mitigation Group maintains a peak blast acoustic buffer radius of 1000 m around critical ungulate wintering sites.
ENVR-ACOUST-F2R：Per the park bioacoustic assessment report modeling detonation sound propagation, the peak blast acoustic buffer radius for the Arlberg Crest Dynamic Blasting Consortium is 500 m.

information_points.title: Maintains wildlife corridor protection and environmental compliance files（HABT）
information_points.content:
ENVR-HABT-9BA：According to the Alpine conservation board review memo assessing candidate blast zone layouts overlapping protected alpine ibex winter habitats, the Arlberg Crest Dynamic Blasting Consortium has received approved wildlife winter refugium exclusion.
ENVR-HABT-60C：Based on the Alpine conservation board review memo covering blast zone layouts overlapping protected alpine ibex winter habitats, the Gotthard Alpine Safety and Telemetry Alliance does not have an approved wildlife winter refugium exclusion.
ENVR-HABT-BE0：The Alpine conservation board review memo confirms that the Tauern High-Pass Avalanche Mitigation Group holds an approved wildlife winter refugium exclusion regarding its blast zone layouts near protected alpine ibex winter habitats.
